$comment: Secrets rotation policy (issue #615). Read by the indexer through indexer/src/secrets/config.ts and by .github/workflows/secrets-rotation.yml. The values here are documentation of the approved posture: the running service reads them from its environment (SECRET_OVERLAP_MS, SECRET_ROTATION_INTERVAL_MS, WEBHOOK_KEY_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS) so a deployment can tighten them without a release. An overlap below 60s is clamped to 60s in code: shorter than that is an outage, not a rotation.

webhook_signing_keys.retire_mechanism: sweep clears webhook_endpoints.previous_secret once updated_at + overlap has elapsed; verification refuses an expired previous key even before the sweep runs
webhook_signing_keys.subscriber_delivery: Streampay-Signature carries one v1 signature per active key during the overlap, so a subscriber holding either key verifies

rpc_credentials.retire_mechanism: candidate is probed against every endpoint before the credential map is swapped; a failing probe aborts the whole update and the previous credential stays active
rpc_credentials.hot_reload: credentials are applied per request, so rotation never closes a connection, aborts an in-flight call, or resets failover state
rpc_credentials.audit: sha256-prefix fingerprints only; credential values are never logged

scheduler.on_failure: abort, keep the previous secret active, emit an alert and record the abort in the audit log; after max_consecutive_failures the scheduler stops retrying until the next successful manual run

reversibility.mechanism: a rotation is a single new version plus a bounded overlap; rolling back means promoting the previous value again with SecretRotationManager.rotate using the provider's previous value — the audit log records both, so the rollback is as visible as the rotation
reversibility.data_loss: none: nothing is deleted, the previous key is retired only by clearing a column or dropping an in-memory version after its window
